findings.summary: WorldSize change before first layout runs Keep() with Bounds 0: Kept clamps X to max(lo, 0-120) = -120, so the map is shoved 120 px off the stage's left/top and never recovers (no Fit on first layout). Run-canvas FitBounds will hit this the same way.
findings.fix: Skip Keep() (and Kept) while Bounds is empty; re-apply on the first non-empty Bounds change. Add a test that sets WorldSize before Show.

findings.summary: No OnPointerCaptureLost: if capture is lost (window deactivates, touch cancel, popup opens) _drag stays set and later pointer moves with no button down keep panning. OnPointerMoved also never checks the left button is still down.
findings.fix: Override OnPointerCaptureLost to clear _drag; in OnPointerMoved drop the drag when !IsLeftButtonPressed. Test with Pointer.Capture(null) mid-drag.

findings.summary: Ports are deduped by point in the same loop that applies per-edge dimming/highlight. If a dimmed edge is drawn first, a port shared with an undimmed or highlighted edge is drawn at 42% and in Wire; ports are also overpainted by the next edge's stroke.
findings.fix: Draw ports in a second pass after all strokes; for each point use full opacity if any edge using it is not dimmed, and WireHi if any is lit. Add a render test.

findings.summary: Min/Max/KeepVisible are consts, and Clamp, Fit, ZoomAt use them statically; Fit takes a Size so the world origin is fixed at 0,0. Run-canvas needs per-instance MinZoom/MaxZoom (0.30-1.50) and FitBounds as a Rect with any origin and scale > 1; this shape forces a rewrite of ZoomView and all its tests.
findings.fix: Make the range a value (record ZoomRange(Min,Max), default 0.62-1.0) passed to Clamp/Fit/ZoomAt/Kept, expose MinZoom/MaxZoom styled properties on ZoomBorder, and change Fit/Kept/WorldSize to take a Rect (origin included) now while there is one caller.

findings.summary: MapEdge carries only Key, Route, Dashed. Run-canvas needs PortSide on both ends, a stroke brush key, dash pattern and hit width per edge; brush keys Brush.Wire/WireHi/Surface1, the 12 px hit width and the 40 px handle are hard-coded in ContextEdgesControl and EdgeRoute.Curve (which is vertical-only and has no 110 cap).
findings.fix: Add optional Stroke/Highlight brush keys and HitWidth to MapEdge now, and give EdgeRoute.Curve (from, fromSide, to, toSide, min, max) before the rename. Dimmed/Highlighted keys stay.
findings.resolution: in writing: run-canvas slice 1 adds PortSide, brush key, hit width and the horizontal curve with the 110 cap

findings.summary: EdgeAt calls Route.DistanceTo, which re-Flattens (allocates a point list, 24+ chords per curve) for every edge on every pointer move; ICustomHitTest runs it on each hit test over the whole layer.
findings.fix: Cache the polyline per edge in Rebuild and prefilter by an inflated bounding box. Render also allocates a Pen, DashStyle and array per edge per frame; build them once.
findings.resolution: in writing: perf is fine at map sizes; revisit with run-canvas

findings.summary: Not keyboard or assistive-tech reachable: Focusable false, no AutomationProperties name or role, and the only zoom entry points are methods. Spec 'Keys' (+ - 0) land in slice 2 on the page, but the control gives the page nothing to name the canvas.
findings.fix: Give the stage an automation name/peer (e.g. 'Context map, pannable') and make the +,-,0 key handling a ZoomBorder method (HandleZoomKey) so slice 2 and the run page share it.

findings.summary: Frame/Settle: a control detached mid-transition leaves _move set (IsMoving true, view stuck mid-way); and Settle then MoveTo leaves the old animation-frame callback alive beside the new one, so two Frame chains run until done.
findings.fix: Settle() in OnDetachedFromVisualTree; carry a generation counter in _move and ignore callbacks from an older one.

findings.summary: Dots brush is cached and its HairlineStrong colour is resolved once; CoverageStrip does the same for the bar brushes. A theme-variant or text-scale change leaves them stale.
The 12 px hit stroke is in world pixels, so at the 0.62 floor it is 7.4 screen px, under the intent of an easy target.
findings.fix: Divide HitWidth by the parent's scale, or note it as accepted.
findings.resolution: in writing: keep world px; revisit if hit testing feels small at 0.62

findings.summary: Reduced motion is tested by setting Motion.Base = 0 on the control's own Resources, which proves the control reads the key but not that the real Motion service writes zero under reduced motion.
findings.fix: Add one test using the app's Motion apply with reduced motion on.
